added: packages/real-observation (@sos-2/real-observation): the REAL observation sources feeding the EXISTING merged P7 Observation Plane. Six source families, every one an EventSourcePort/TelemetrySource/ProbePort over an INJECTED FetchPort seam (zero ambient network in src; bindGlobalFetch only at the process boundary): (1) GitHub repository events — the webhook-shaped receiver (X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC fail-closed, node:http inbound bind adapter, zero outbound network) PLUS the REST events-API polling fallback with the PAT, one envelope contract for both delivery shapes, replay-protected by GitHub's own durable event ids; (2) CI results — GitHub Actions runs per commit (per_page runs API), status carried VERBATIM (SUCCESS/FAILURE/IN_PROGRESS/QUEUED/UNKNOWN — never folded), status transitions are new observations (external id embeds the observed status); (3) deployment events — the Vercel deployments API read DIRECTLY (no sibling P17-A dependency): only READY deployments with git metadata map to deployment.change; rollbacks map to rolled-back; deployments of OTHER repositories are filtered by the honest subject binding (githubRepoFilter) and never projected onto the observed subject; BUILDING/QUEUED deployments never fabricate events; (4) runtime telemetry — real W3 TelemetrySource adapters (buffered-sync per the merged contract): the GitHub rate-limit budget, the live Upstash Redis runtime (POST /pipeline PING+DBSIZE) and a generic JSON metrics endpoint; failed pulls surface as typed TelemetryRuntime failures (never fabricated gap captures); (5) scheduled probes — real fallback probes (repo branch head, latest CI run, latest deployment) behind the merged ProbeScheduler + CoverageLedger (run only while organic coverage is insufficient; SKIPPED_COVERED stand-down); (6) provider health — real per-provider probes emitting provider-health.signal events with honest HEALTHY/DEGRADED/UNAVAILABLE statuses plus the aggregate four-state machine. THE HONEST-STATE MACHINE (program-defining): every source reports CONNECTED/UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE/DEGRADED derived ONLY from real probe records — unprobed is UNKNOWN (never health), a down provider is UNAVAILABLE with the real error recorded verbatim (redacted), a 429-throttled provider is DEGRADED; the aggregate takes the worst probed state per provider. Every real round-trip is recorded in a REDACTED transcript (Authorization -> env-NAME reference; bodies/snippets through the P17-C redaction corpus — pattern ids aligned with the merged @sos-2/security twelve-pattern corpus plus the two lane additions vercel-access-token and bearer-token-value). The composition (createRealObservationPlane) mirrors the apps/observation reference composition one-to-one (same subject keys, same coverage/projection/detection wiring) with the real sources; configFromEnv is a PURE function over a caller-supplied env record (zero ambient process.env in src).

apps/web/live-mission: the live UX surface as a NEW self-contained module (the P4 apps/web/onboarding precedent — components + view-state + action envelopes + render tests, all under the P17-C owned path; the existing shell/routes/nav are read-only, the one-file mount is the architect's P18 pass, documented in MOUNTING.md). The surface: (1) mission becomes ACTIONABLE — Start mission / Import system / Resume existing mission entry points replacing the read-only mission view (new files only; the P18 structural fix) with onboarding discoverable as a first-class entry; (2) the LIVE observation view — honest source states (CONNECTED/UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE/DEGRADED chips with the real recorded errors visible), repository branch heads with freshness + evidence event ids, CI latest runs with statuses verbatim, deployments, reconciliation findings (ALIGNED/DIVERGED/UNVERIFIED/STALE — retained uncertainty stays visible), detections and provider health, ALL carrying LIVE provenance ({kind:'LIVE', store_ref, as_of} — the merged web-contracts DataSource LIVE variant, so live state can never render as DEMO fixture state or vice versa) and the six product review questions (what/why/evidence/uncertainty/authority/next); (3) CONSEQUENTIAL ACTION WIRING — every action goes through the merged authority-gated action gateway: the UI renders typed ActionRequest envelopes (body-lifecycle summon / promotion / rollback) built by pure envelope builders, POSTs to the documented gateway endpoint (LIVE_ACTION_ENDPOINT, mounted by P18), and NEVER mutates state directly; ASK resolution flows through the merged AskQueue (human authority); package composition has NO merged action-gateway family and is honestly linked to the Packages workspace instead of fabricated. The DTO producer (liveObservationFromDrain) maps the merged drain report + the P17-C connectivity snapshot to serializable view data (structural typing — no dependency edge from apps/web); emptyLiveObservation renders the honest UNKNOWN state until the data plane is wired.

(1) the DETERMINISTIC REFERENCE-MODE SUITE (default, no network, run-to-run identical): source→plane→System State contract compliance over scripted FetchPorts (event shapes verbatim; replay protection — identical drains double-apply NOTHING; the no-body rule — task and body-lease stores stay empty through full drains; the plane writes ONLY the observation-event store; ALIGNED/DIVERGED/STALE/UNVERIFIED reconciliation; the probe fallback runs-then-stands-down; the webhook receiver feeding the SAME plane; typed POLL_FAILED never fabricated success), the honest-state machine (UNKNOWN/CONNECTED/UNAVAILABLE/DEGRADED + aggregate + redacted transcripts), the consequential action wiring through the REAL merged gateway (held grant executes with evidence; revoked/expired/never-held grants fail CLOSED with the executor never invoked; idempotent replay returns the recorded receipt with exactly one world transition; smuggled authority fields typed-rejected; rollback evidence + verification records; ASK resolution through the merged AskQueue minting the Decision record, terminal on resolution), the live-mission view projections (LIVE provenance, honest states, retained uncertainty, serializable boundary) plus the deterministic UI wiring evidence (live-data-derived envelopes through the real gateway), the redaction-corpus alignment with the merged @sos-2/security patterns (twelve shared ids + equivalent verdicts, pinned by importing the merged corpus source through the test-time alias), and structural scans (no ambient network/time/env in owned src outside the documented boundaries; UI imports restricted to apps/web's declared dependencies; NO secret values committed — synthetic fixtures only; pnpm-workspace.yaml untouched).
